source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
Whenever this model carries out a **[Normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move)**, **[Advance move](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move)** or **[Fall Back move](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back)**:

- models other than **TITANIC** models, and terrain feature sections 4" tall or less, do not block it
- it can enter [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of an enemy model during the move but cannot finish the move there
- it can also pass through terrain feature sections taller than 4", but if it does, roll a D6 after the move: on a 1, it becomes **[Battle-shocked](vsdata:core-rule/battle-shock)**
